odontoiatria-generale.title: General dentistry
odontoiatria-generale.lead: Conservative dentistry, endodontics, periodontology and hygiene: the basic care for healthy teeth and gums.
intro: General dentistry covers the basic care of the mouth: conservative dentistry, endodontics, periodontology and hygiene.

seo.title: General dentistry in Milan
seo.description: Conservative dentistry, endodontics, periodontology and hygiene at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9.

estetica-dentale.title: Cosmetic dentistry
intro: In the cosmetic dentistry area, the practice performs whitening.

seo.title: Cosmetic dentistry in Milan
seo.description: Teeth whitening at Studio Liddi in Milan, at Via Rovigo 9, near the Crescenzago metro station.

implantologia.title: Implantology
implantologia.lead: Implantology, oral surgery (including wisdom tooth surgery) and prosthetics.
intro: This area covers implantology, oral surgery and prosthetics: from replacing missing teeth to bone reconstruction.

seo.title: Implantology in Milan
seo.description: Implantology, oral surgery and prosthetics at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9.

ortodonzia.title: Orthodontics
intro: In the orthodontics area the practice deals with aligning the teeth and correcting the bite, with Dr Sara Sanguini, who specialises in orthodontics.

seo.title: Orthodontics in Milan
seo.description: Orthodontics at Studio Liddi in Milan, at Via Rovigo 9: aligning the teeth and correcting the bite.

conservativa.title: Conservative dentistry
conservativa.short: Treatment of decay and restoration of damaged teeth.
conservativa.lead: Conservative dentistry treats and restores damaged teeth, with the aim of keeping them.
intro: Conservative dentistry covers the treatments that allow the natural tooth to be kept: from treating decay to rebuilding the damaged part.

seo.title: Conservative dentistry in Milan
seo.description: Conservative dentistry at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: treatment of decay and restoration of damaged teeth.

endodonzia.title: Endodontics
endodonzia.short: Treatment of the pulp and root canals of teeth.
endodonzia.lead: Endodontics is treatment inside the tooth, also known as root canal treatment.
intro: Endodontics treats the pulp and root canals of a tooth when they are inflamed or infected, with the aim of saving the tooth.
indicated: Deep decay that has reached the pulp

seo.title: Endodontics in Milan
seo.description: Endodontics at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: treatment of the pulp and root canals of teeth.

parodontologia.title: Periodontology
parodontologia.short: Treatment of the gums and the tissues that support the teeth.
parodontologia.lead: Periodontology deals with the health of the gums and the tissues that support the teeth.
intro: Periodontology prevents and treats the diseases that affect the gums and the tissues supporting the tooth.
Dr Liddi also performs specific gum and periodontal procedures.

seo.title: Periodontology in Milan
seo.description: Periodontology at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: treatment of the gums and the tissues supporting the teeth.

igiene-e-prevenzione.title: Dental hygiene
igiene-e-prevenzione.lead: Professional hygiene is part of the basic care of general dentistry.
intro: Professional dental hygiene consists of removing plaque and tartar from the teeth.
indicated: Regular check of the health of teeth and gums

seo.title: Dental hygiene in Milan
seo.description: Professional dental hygiene at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9.

sbiancamento.title: Whitening
sbiancamento.lead: Whitening lightens the colour of the teeth.
intro: Dental whitening is a cosmetic treatment used to lighten the colour of the teeth.
indicated: Teeth that have darkened or yellowed over time

seo.title: Teeth whitening in Milan
seo.description: Teeth whitening at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: a cosmetic treatment to lighten the colour of the teeth.

impianti-dentali.title: Dental implants
impianti-dentali.short: Replacing missing teeth with endosseous implants.
impianti-dentali.lead: Endosseous implants replace the root of missing teeth.
intro: An endosseous implant is a screw placed in the bone that replaces the root of a missing tooth and supports the prosthetic crown.
Dr Liddi specialised in endosseous implants and bone reconstruction and attended the implantology department of the university clinic for over fifteen years.

seo.title: Dental implants in Milan
seo.description: Endosseous dental implants at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: replacing missing teeth.

chirurgia-orale.title: Oral surgery
chirurgia-orale.short: Oral surgery, including wisdom tooth surgery.
chirurgia-orale.lead: Oral surgery covers surgical procedures in the mouth, including wisdom tooth surgery.
intro: The practice performs oral surgery, including wisdom tooth surgery and bone reconstruction.

seo.title: Oral surgery in Milan
seo.description: Oral surgery at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: wisdom tooth surgery and bone reconstruction.

protesi.title: Prosthetics
protesi.lead: Prosthetics replaces or rebuilds missing or badly compromised teeth.
intro: Dental prosthetics restores the function and appearance of missing or badly damaged teeth.

seo.title: Dental prosthetics in Milan
seo.description: Dental prosthetics at Studio Liddi in Milan, Via Rovigo 9: rebuilding missing or badly damaged teeth.

ortodonzia-tradizionale.title: Orthodontics
ortodonzia-tradizionale.short: Aligning the teeth and correcting the bite.
ortodonzia-tradizionale.lead: Orthodontics corrects the position of the teeth and the jaws.
intro: Orthodontics deals with aligning the teeth and correcting the way the arches close; orthognathodontics studies the position of the teeth and the jaws.

seo.title: Orthodontics in Milan
seo.description: Orthodontics at Studio Liddi in Milan, at Via Rovigo 9: aligning the teeth and correcting the bite.
